asya jīvanmuktasya tena suhṛdā saha yadramaṇaṃ tatkiṃ svabhāvaḥ
svātmasvarūpāvasthitireva vā syāduta ratiḥ ramyeṣu bhogasthāneṣu vihāraprayuktā
prītistadātmakamityarthaḥ

pravāhehitaṃ sahajaṃ karma prāyehitaṃ lokasaṃgrahārthaṃ śāstrīyaṃ karma
svaprayatnābhyastaṃ
sacchāstrābhyāsavicārasatsaṃgaśamadamatitikṣoparamaśaucasaṃtoṣeśvaratribhirnāmabhirupādhibhedādvyapadiśyate

evaṃ durgeṣu durgameṣu mārgeṣu durvāravairakalahādidoṣeṣu ca majjane prasakte
uddharaṇatatparam

sacceṣṭāḥ śubhā
vāṅmanaḥkāyaceṣṭāstallakṣaṇānāṃ maṇimāṇikyānāṃ bhāṇḍasaṃbhāramandiraṃ
kośagṛham

kāmebhya upaśāntamata eva
satāṃ rūpamiva rūpaṃ yasya sadrūpam

ajñānebhyo janebhyo daivātsamudbhūte raṇe saṃprahāre pūrvaṃ praharaṇe
udyatamatiśūramiti yāvat

viśeṣato vidyāvaidagdhyena pāṇḍityena vādaiśca vandyānāmutkṛṣṭānāṃ
prabhugurumānyādīnāṃ vinodanaṃ kautukāvaham
svabhāvena sahajavṛttyaiva na tu kenacidīritaḥ preritaḥ sannityarthaḥ

tatsahitasya tadīyasya mitrasya tatkalatraṃ kiṃ tacca kiṃ
rūpaṃ kīdṛśaguṇavadityarthaḥ
tasya bhāryāṃ guṇaiḥ saha varṇayati - candralekheveti
karuṇā dayā tatkāraṇāt āsamantātkīrṇaṃ vikṣiptaṃ vikīrṇaṃ dhanaṃ yayā
dhairye dharme ca viṣaye yā dhīḥ sā

asya rājñaḥ suhṛdo viṣayārijaye viṣaye mantrapradāyinī maitrī nāmāparā bhāryā
samatayā samaṃ sarvadaiva skandhe sannā saktā

evaṃvidhaḥ parivāraḥ poṣyavargo yasya tathāvidhena mantriṇā suhṛdā svakarmaṇā
sarvatra vyavaharan jīvanmukto lābhālābhayorna hṛṣyati na kupyati
